title: A Hot Monday
setting: A sunny outdoor cafe on a summer day.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt)

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt)

sentences.en: The cafe is busy on a hot July Monday.
sentences.zh: 七月一个炎热的星期一，咖啡馆里很热闹。
sentences.scene_prompt: A busy sunny outdoor cafe with small tables, striped umbrellas and many people fanning themselves in the summer heat.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a busy cafe on a hot summer day; the month and the day of the week can't be shown.

sentences.en: Sara finds a seat at the cafe.
sentences.zh: 萨拉在咖啡馆找到一个座位。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) spots the only empty chair at a small table in the busy outdoor cafe.

sentences.en: She sits down with a purple cup.
sentences.zh: 她拿着一个紫色杯子坐下。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) sits down at the cafe table holding a purple cup.

sentences.en: Kofi comes in and says hello to her.
sentences.zh: 科菲走进来，跟她打招呼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) walks into the cafe and waves hello to Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) at her table.

sentences.en: He opens the top of his water bottle.
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt), sitting next to Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt), twists the top off his water bottle.

sentences.en: He looks in again, but there is zero water.
sentences.zh: 他又往里看了看，可是一点水也没有。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) holds his empty water bottle upside down and peers into it with a sad face; not a drop comes out.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Kofi looking into an empty bottle; 'again' can't be shown.

sentences.en: “Help yourself to my water,” says Sara.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) smiles and pushes a big jug of water across the table toward Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt).
sentences.draw_note: Shows Sara offering her jug of water to Kofi; her words can't be shown.

sentences.en: They listen to music; Kofi wants nothing else.
sentences.zh: 他们听着音乐，科菲别的什么都不想要了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) sit back and listen to a street musician playing a guitar near the cafe, Kofi happily holding his full bottle.
sentences.draw_note: Shows them listening to music and Kofi happy with his water; 'wants nothing else' can't be shown.
